acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for storm damage roof repair in the DFW area, look for companies with local experience, proper licensing, and good references. Verify they are familiar with local building codes and common storm patterns in North Texas. It's also important to ensure they are insured and can provide a clear scope of work and warranty information.
